editorial_thesis: The most useful frontier signal today is moving from autonomous demos to bounded systems: redact sensitive inputs, isolate generated actions, evaluate recovery, and require scoped authorization for spend.

topic_groups.title: Privacy-First AI Infrastructure
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A practical gap after several agent-runtime days: local PII and secret handling is a prerequisite for useful memory, logs, and client data workflows.

sources.title: OpenAI Privacy Filter
sources.why_selected: Open-weight 1.5B/50M-active token classifier for local PII and secret detection, with 128k-token inputs and tunable precision/recall.
sources.usefulness: Add a redaction gate before Buildn research indexing, logs, and client handoffs.

sources.title: Cloudflare: new AI traffic options
sources.why_selected: Controls for deciding how site content is exposed to AI crawlers and agents.
sources.usefulness: Use as a client content-governance checklist: allow, block, or monetize machine access by route.

sources.title: OpenAI Zero Data Retention for frontier models
sources.why_selected: A privacy posture for frontier-model use, with Private Safety Processing planned for September.
sources.usefulness: Map provider retention modes to each workflow’s data classification.

sources.title: OWASP GenAI Security Project
sources.why_selected: A living reference for threat classes and mitigations across generative-AI systems.
sources.usefulness: Turn threat categories into acceptance tests for agent features.

topic_groups.title: Agent Runtimes + Sandboxes
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh implementation signal spans isolate-level execution, policy-driven sandboxes, durable serving, and user-facing event protocols—an under-covered bridge from demo to production.

sources.title: Cloudflare Dynamic Worker Loader
sources.why_selected: Open-beta runtime-loadable Workers provide millisecond isolates, capability injection, and outbound-network controls for generated code.
sources.usefulness: Prototype high-volume Code Mode tasks without a container per request.

sources.title: NVIDIA OpenShell
sources.why_selected: Policy-driven sandbox runtime using kernel controls, Rego policy, and network mediation for autonomous agents.
sources.usefulness: Compare its enforcement points with Hermes environment backends.

sources.title: AgentScope Runtime
sources.why_selected: Open-source runtime focused on durable agent serving and secure sandbox lifecycle management.
sources.usefulness: Evaluate as a reference architecture for “agent as API” with stateful sessions.

sources.title: NEAR AI IronClaw
sources.why_selected: Privacy-first agent harness with WASM tools, capability permissions, encrypted local storage, memory, and MCP support.
sources.usefulness: Test a local-first assistant where tools and credentials cross an explicit host boundary.

sources.title: AG-UI protocol
sources.why_selected: Event-based protocol for connecting agents to user-facing applications.
sources.usefulness: Use typed events to make approvals, progress, and partial results visible in client work.

topic_groups.title: Embodied AI: Research Signals
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Today’s robotics feed offers a genuinely fresh lane with same-day papers, complementing recent physical-AI coverage with concrete research directions rather than another platform announcement.

sources.title: SUN: Persistent Programs for Language-Grounded Control
sources.why_selected: A program-like approach to language-grounded control, learning, and real-robot policies.
sources.usefulness: Borrow the persistent-program framing for long-running agent workflows with checkpoints.

sources.title: Language-Driven Quality-Diversity Manipulation
sources.why_selected: Uses language to acquire diverse manipulation skills rather than optimizing one behavior.
sources.usefulness: Explore skill libraries that expose multiple viable strategies to a client workflow.

sources.title: LightNav-0
sources.why_selected: A VLM navigation report targeting spatial intelligence for generalist embodied navigation.
sources.usefulness: Track spatial grounding as a distinct eval dimension for multimodal agents.

sources.title: Zeva: In-Context Causal Learning
sources.why_selected: In-context causal learning for more generalizable embodied manipulation.
sources.usefulness: Use causal hypotheses and intervention logs as a design pattern for tool recovery.

sources.title: Temporal Forcing for VLA Models
sources.why_selected: 4D representation alignment aimed at improving temporal action understanding.
sources.usefulness: Add temporal alignment checks to video-to-action or inspection workflows.

topic_groups.title: Agentic Commerce + Wallets
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A new payments surface earns inclusion because it converts agent authorization from an abstract protocol question into a concrete, reviewable spend flow with merchant-level restrictions.

sources.title: Link’s wallet for agents
sources.why_selected: Stripe lets agents request one-time cards or Shared Payment Tokens without receiving raw credentials; users approve in Link.
sources.usefulness: Prototype approval-gated purchasing or paid API access with explicit intent.

sources.title: Stripe Sessions 2026 announcements
sources.why_selected: Stripe describes agentic-commerce expansion, agent wallets, and Checkout Studio alongside broader payment infrastructure.
sources.usefulness: Use the announcement as a map of primitives to watch, not as an implementation spec.

sources.title: Machine Payments Protocol
sources.why_selected: An internet-native approach to pay-per-call and pay-per-task agent requests.
sources.usefulness: Model small paid tool calls as explicit business events with idempotency and webhooks.

sources.title: Agentic Commerce Suite
sources.why_selected: A seller-facing stack for making products discoverable and purchasable through AI agents.
sources.usefulness: Audit a client catalog for agent-readable product data and bounded offers.
